_note: Two steps, not three. The opener is `world.final_stretch_press`, and it is NOT a step: a card cannot be both the thing that starts an arc and a step that arc gates — §10.10 excludes steps from the pool, so such a card can never fire at all. invalidate_when fades the arc only on a SIGNED Series A (or the bootstrap milestone), never on phase.series_a_signal == open: an open signal is not a closed round, and in phase 3 the signal is always open, so fading on it would end the warning before the comment and Frank's verdict could come.
